description: Fetches any public URL and returns structured on-page SEO signals: title, meta description, canonical (+ canonicalCount), lang, heading counts, schema types (JSON-LD including @graph and nested entities, plus microdata and schema.org RDFa; schemaTypesBySyntax splits them), OpenGraph/Twitter cards (any attribute order), internal/external link counts, word count (body text without scripts, templates, comments; see wordCountMethod), and whether markdown is served for Accept: text/markdown. Text values are entity-decoded. pageLoaded:false means the checker was refused or got an error or challenge page; then title, schemaTypes and wordCount are null (unknown, not empty). markdownNegotiation is null with markdownNegotiationChecked:false when the markdown probe was refused.
name: analyze_page
